attchmntText: Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Debidas Datta as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited filed an update regarding the resignation of Mr. Debidas Datta, DIN 00229856. The resignation from the Board and its committees is effective from 12th November 2026, at the close of business hours. Mr. Datta cited a potential conflict of interest as the reason for stepping down. He intends to transition to a professional advisory role focusing on Arbitration and Dispute Resolution matters for the Company, subject to requisite regulatory approvals. The Company confirmed there are no other material reasons for the resignation. An updated letter of resignation was attached to the intimation filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations 2014 on 12th November 2026. The information is provided for the record of the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited.

attchmntText: Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Debidas Datta as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has intimated that Mr. Debidas Datta, DIN 00229856, has tendered his resignation as Independent Director from the Board and its Committees. The resignation is effective from the closure of business hours on 12th November 2026. The stated reason for the resignation is to avoid potential conflict of interest. Mr. Datta has confirmed that there are no other material reasons for his departure. The Company expressed appreciation for his services and contributions during his tenure. The resignation letter and detailed reasons are enclosed with the filing. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the results on 12th November 2026. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 3,466.06 lakhs. The company reported a loss after tax of 4,068.94 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at negative 12.21. Total assets were 81,603.09 lakhs. The Board also approved a Postal Ballot Notice seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of Mr. Pradumn Kumar Dixit as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. The notice will be dispatched to members on the cut-off date of 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Pradumn Dixit as Non- Executive Non - Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 02, 2026.
